lines: This terminal loads command metadata from data/terminal-protocol.json and route bodies from data/terminal-content/*.json.
block.image -> { type: "image", src, alt?, caption?, maxColumns?, maxRows? }
Image blocks sample source pixels on a canvas, reduce resolution, map brightness to glyphs, and keep sampled color as phosphor tint.
Introspection -> window.NatsuFoxTerminalProtocol.describe() returns schema, routes, themes, artifact path, and cache policy.
